FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Accounting Solutions specializes in providing a range of accounting and financial services exclusively for individual taxpayers and small businesses with straightforward financial needs. Our core operations include individual tax preparation, basic bookkeeping, and payroll processing, ensuring compliance with the latest tax regulations. We maintain accurate financial records for sole proprietors and small partnerships using secure, industry-standard accounting software. Our team comprises certified public accountants (CPAs) and trained bookkeepers, all up-to-date with industry best practices. We prioritize client data security through robust protocols and maintain professional liability insurance for all accounting services offered. Transparency is essential; therefore, we establish clear, written client engagement agreements that outline services and fees, ensuring a trustworthy relationship with our clients. Regular internal audits are conducted to verify compliance with legal and industry standards, reinforcing our commitment to excellence in accounting service delivery.
